text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-san, happy birthday! Um... I have a 
present for you...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You dedicate an immense amount of effort 
to maintaining peak physical condition, 
don't you, Ramonu-san? No—there's no need 
to say another word, I understand 
completely!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can tell just by looking! Ramonu-san, 
your fine, delicate skin is the result of 
countless cycles of cellular turnover from 
sheer effort!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So, we came up with an easy health routine 
for the two of us to stay in shape without 
any hassle! And that is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've picked out stretches that help flush 
bodily waste into the bloodstream! I'll be 
right beside you, supporting you step by 
step, hand in hand!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I picked out the aromas myself, blending 
ylang-ylang and lavender oils!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ylang-ylang promotes sweating to improve 
blood flow, while lavender simultaneously 
relaxes you, making it effective for 
reducing stress!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so? ...Hehe, how admirable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Very well. Please, show me the ropes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...! W-We did it...! We did it, Dober!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's do our best, Ryan...!
